title: Jump Game
summary: Each value says how far you may jump from that index. Decide whether you can reach the last index.

tests.explain: Jump from index 0 to index 2 (2 steps), then from index 2 jump 2 more steps to the last index.
Every route lands on index 2, whose value is 0. Nothing before it can jump past it, so index 4 is out of reach.
You start on the last index, so there is nothing to do.

hints: You don't need to know which jumps to make, only how far you could possibly get. What is the furthest index reachable so far?
Scan left to right, keeping reach = the furthest index any visited position can jump to. If you arrive at an index beyond reach, you are stuck.
For each i: if i > reach, return false; otherwise reach = max(reach, i + nums[i]). If the loop finishes, the last index was reachable.
